variables.name: WorkspaceId
variables.note: Id of the workspace that holds the repository database and the Warehouse.

variables.name: RepositoryDatabaseItemId
variables.note: Item id of the SQL database in Fabric that holds the DIRECT repository (omd schema).

variables.name: RepositoryConnectionId
variables.note: Id of a Fabric SQL database connection (OAuth2, caller identity) to the repository database.

variables.name: WarehouseItemId
variables.note: Item id of the Fabric Warehouse that holds the data and the Module executables (procedures).

variables.name: WarehouseConnectionId
variables.note: Id of a Warehouse connection (OAuth2, caller identity) to the Warehouse.

variables.name: ModuleInstanceIdColumnName
variables.note: Column that holds the Module Instance Id in the target data objects; used to build rollback statements.

variables.name: DefaultStartValue
variables.note: Load window start value for a Module that has no load window recorded yet.

variables.name: ConsistencyModuleTypeList
variables.note: Comma-separated Module Types that receive a consistency timestamp (omd.GetConsistencyTimestamp). Empty for none.

variables.name: LoadWindowAttributeName
variables.note: Attribute whose maximum value in the source data object is the end of the load window.
